reason: Local prerequisite lemma added because the design's routes for the heap classification and the interval theorem both need finite-poset linear extensions: existence by removing minimal elements, extension of a prescribed ideal as an initial segment, and adjacent-incomparable-swap connectivity of linear extensions. Proofs re-derived in full and recorded in the strategy; a listing of the finite poset replaces an arbitrary choice function, so only the well-ordering of the naturals is used, no AC. Dependencies are published items only: def-partial-order, def-maximal-element, def-chain, def-lattice-distributive-lattice-and-order-ideal. Sources read: Stembridge Prop. 1.2 proof and Prop. 2.3's contiguity sentence, Nadeau section 2.3, Krattenthaler section 3.
